metrics.name: 破产率
metrics.definition: 破产率 = 破产用户数（指标 152）/ SPIN用户数（指标 145）。分子继承破产用户数的当前口径：在 bbs_dwd.dwd_gam_slot_log_rt 中先按 user_id、game_id、spin_times 归并同一局，按 buff11、log_date、log_id 的既定顺序确定结算记录，以归并后的 end_money < bet_money 判定破产，并按 user_id 去重；分母继承 SPIN用户数口径：筛选 game_type = 0 后按 user_id 去重。两者使用相同的 log_date 时间范围及公共维度筛选，先分别聚合再相除；分母为 0 时返回 NULL，跨时间或维度汇总时按总分子/总分母重算。
metrics.example: 统计指定时间范围内的破产率
metrics.sql:
-- 分子继承已发布原子指标 152，分母继承已发布原子指标 145；不固化统计日期。
-- 公共时间及维度筛选必须分别下推到两个源表查询后再聚合；平台自动注入位置尚未验证。
select
    cast(
        (
            select count(distinct user_id)
            from (
                select
                    user_id,
                    game_id,
                    spin_times,
                    max(bet_money) as bet_money,
                    max(case when rn_settle = 1 then end_money end) as end_money
                from (
                    select
                        user_id,
                        game_id,
                        spin_times,
                        bet_money,
                        end_money,
                        row_number() over (
                            partition by user_id, game_id, spin_times
                            order by case when buff11 = 0 then 0 else 1 end, log_date desc, log_id desc
                        ) as rn_settle
                    from bbs_dwd.dwd_gam_slot_log_rt
                ) as spin_detail
                group by
                    user_id,
                    game_id,
                    spin_times
            ) as settled_spin
            where end_money < bet_money
        ) as double
    ) / nullif(
        (
            select count(distinct user_id)
            from bbs_dwd.dwd_gam_slot_log_rt
            where game_type = 0
        ),
        0
    ) as broke_rate;

metrics.name: 付费等级
metrics.definition: 用户付费等级，包含小R、中R、大R、超R、VIPR、非R等
metrics.sql:
select 
    user_id,
    case when t.infull_amount/100 > 0 and t.infull_amount/100 <= 100 then '小R'
        when t.infull_amount/100 > 100 and t.infull_amount/100 <= 1000 then '中R'
        when t.infull_amount/100 > 1000 and t.infull_amount/100 <= 10000 then '大R'
        when t.infull_amount/100 > 10000 and t.infull_amount/100 <= 50000 then '超R'
        when t.infull_amount/100 > 50000 then 'VIPR'
        else '非R'
      end infull_level
from 
    (
    select 
        user_id,
        sum(amount) infull_amount
    from bbs_ods.infull_order
    where order_state in (1,3)
          and if_sandbox = 0
    group by user_id
    ) t
